note: Stop neuron E2 alone on the unmodified base (no repetition repair). E2: neuron 1998 of the last MLP (layer 23) replaced by a stop detector for concluding line ends: gate = c - 25 o, up = c - 23 o, down = b2 v (c: difference of means between line ends that state the answer and all other positions in the base model's activations, unit length; o: closed-form near-constant reference direction; v: readout row of </think> made orthogonal to its 12 nearest token rows). Raises the </think> logit only at line ends that conclude a result.
